name: application-combobox
title: Combobox
description: Filterable text input paired with a listbox of matching options, with a selected state and a no-match fallback.
useWhen: The option list is long enough that typing to filter is faster than scrolling a plain select.
Users need to search by typing a few characters rather than recognizing an option in a closed list.
Assigning or picking from a people/tag/entity list where free-text search is the natural interaction.
avoidWhen: The option list is short (under ~8 items) — a plain `selects` dropdown is simpler and needs no typing.
Users must be able to enter a value not in the list — this pattern implies picking from known options, not free text with suggestions.
You only need single-key-press selection — a native <select> is more efficient and needs no custom listbox/aria wiring.
responsiveBehavior: The listbox matches the input's width and stays anchored below it; it does not reflow to other edges on its own — pair with viewport-aware positioning if used near a screen edge.
accessibility: The input carries role="combobox" with aria-expanded and aria-controls pointing at the listbox.
The listbox has role="listbox" with an aria-label describing what it lists, and each option has role="option" with aria-selected.
The zero-results state is a non-interactive option with aria-disabled="true" rather than being silently empty.
The search icon is decorative and marked aria-hidden.

variants.title: Combobox
variants.description: Filterable assignee search with a matched, selected, and no-match option state.
accessibility: Typing filters the real option list; the listbox announces the current match count implicitly through its rendered options.

variants.title: Combobox (Dark)
variants.description: Filterable assignee search adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Selected and hover option backgrounds are tuned to meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark surface.
